text:
I finished my first half marathon in Bengaluru, crossing the line in 2:05:30.

The biggest lesson from this journey: consistency beat motivation. Motivation came and went. Showing up anyway is what got me to the finish.

A huge thank you to my running group, Sunday Striders. I couldn't have done this without you.

On to the next one.

#HalfMarathon #Running #Consistency
